scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:android: npm run build && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.cap:ios: npm run build && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.cap:run:android: npm run build && npx cap sync && npx cap run android
scripts.cap:run:ios: npm run build && npx cap sync && npx cap run ios
scripts.build:apk:debug: npm run build && npx cap sync && cd android && gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:apk:release: npm run build && npx cap sync && cd android && gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.build:aab: npm run build && npx cap sync && cd android && gradlew bundleRelease
